_help: Places Echo opens when asked ("Hey Echo, open the Weather Channel"). 'names' are what people say; 'url' opens in Chrome; 'script' runs one of Echo's own scripts instead; 'ask' answers with a question instead of opening anything, and 'answers' maps the reply to a shortcut. To open a page as a particular Google account, add ?authuser=you@gmail.com to its url (that account must be signed in to Chrome). See README for a two-account example.
